name: daily switch-back after the upstream merge
why: The Platform Engineer's daily fork switch-back (lean-core 5e): upstream merged PR #412, so the change removes the meetings fork and moves the product pin forward to the newest commit of the product's main, which holds the merge. That newest commit naturally carries the main commits made since the old pin (here a dependency bump, 6b2d8f0, which the card lists before the merge commit, the newest): a switch-back always upgrades to an official sha, never to the merge commit alone, and official commits are not out of scope. Returning to official code is the reviewer's alone (Tier 1): approve.

card.sentence: Apply a change to the fleet's configuration (commit b47d03f9a1c2).
card.reason: module changes without new authority: meetings: fork → official; meetings: text only
